reports.name: Detention Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the document by its own Detention Report title, which may appear in the heading and footer. Opening court, hearing, and case-identification fields support recognition; discussion of detention in another document does not establish this report name.

reports.name: Initial Hearing Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the document by its own Initial Hearing Report title. A reference to an initial hearing, or a document prepared for that hearing, is not sufficient by itself.

reports.name: Jurisdiction Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify a separately titled Jurisdiction Report. A document explicitly titled Jurisdiction/Disposition Report belongs to the combined entry, not this standalone name.

reports.name: Disposition Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify a separately titled Disposition Report. A document explicitly titled Jurisdiction/Disposition Report belongs to the combined entry, not this standalone name.

reports.name: Jurisdiction/Disposition Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the combined Jurisdiction/Disposition Report from its own title in the heading or footer, supported by the opening report identification. Spacing around the slash may vary; return this combined name rather than either standalone name.

reports.name: Last Minute Information
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Recognize the heading Last Minute Information for the Court. Child, court, department, hearing, and worker fields, Information only / Change in Recommendation boxes, and a DCFS 4216 footer are supporting clues, not required features. An incidental reference to last-minute information is not a match.

reports.name: Non-Detained Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the document by its own Non-Detained Report title; ordinary hyphenation or spacing may vary. A statement that a child is not detained does not establish this report name.

reports.name: Status Review Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the document by its own Status Review Report title, often repeated in the footer. Opening hearing and case-identification fields support recognition. References to review hearings or recommendations for a later hearing do not change the report’s own identity.

reports.name: Interim Review Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the document by its own Interim Review Report title. A Progress Report heading may match when the report’s own footer identifies it as Interim Review Report and the opening report context supports that identity. Progress Report or Special/Interim hearing wording alone is insufficient.

reports.name: Review Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify an agency report with its own Review Report or 15 Day Review Report title. This is not a catch-all for titles containing the words review report; separately named Status Review, Interim Review, and Permanent Plan Review reports retain their own identities. Do not use this entry for CASA Review Hearing Reports.

reports.name: Addendum Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the document by its own Addendum Report title and fresh report-identification opening. An Additional Information section or a reference to an addendum within another document is not itself an Addendum Report.

reports.name: Petition Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify an agency report explicitly titled Petition Report. Do not use this name for a Juvenile Dependency Petition, its allegation pages, or a report that merely discusses a petition.

reports.name: 366.26 WIC Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the document by its own 366.26 WIC Report title; the observed title Continued WIC 366.26 is also a matching variant. A section 366.26 citation, hearing-type field, or recommendation to schedule that hearing does not establish this report name.

reports.name: Permanent Plan Review Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the document by its own Permanent Plan Review Report title. References to a permanent plan, a future review hearing, or a direction to prepare another report are insufficient.

reports.name: RPP Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify RPP Report as the document’s own report title or identifying footer, supported by an opening report context. An RPP hearing label or an order directing preparation of an RPP Report is not the report itself.

reports.name: Selection and Implementation Report
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Identify the document by its own Selection and Implementation Report title. Do not infer this name solely from a selection-and-implementation hearing field or treat a report explicitly titled 366.26 WIC Report as this differently named entry.

reports.name: Additional Information for Court
reports.guidance: Court-directed child-welfare agency report. Recognize the agency update titled Additional Information for Court or Additional Information to the Court. Initial child/hearing tables, an Information for the Court area, and a CFS 6.7 footer are supporting clues, not requirements. Do not match an internal Additional Information section or a differently titled CASA Additional Information Report.
